entries.example: The Amish are known for being slow to adopt modern technology.
entries.description: Start to use a new idea or way of doing things

entries.example: There are many different groups, but the strongest community is the Old Order Amish.
entries.description: A group of people who live together or share beliefs

entries.description: Not liking change; keeping old traditions
